subject: Pinned Version Sunset & Fast Reversion Protocol for FinServe VPC Cutover
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alex Park <alex.park@finserve.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 29 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pinned Version Sunset & Fast Reversion Protocol for FinServe VPC Cutover

Alex —

Following up on our queue for the May/June maintenance window: we need your sign-off on the exact pin/unpin timings and the emergency reversion path for the Private deployment in your VPC. High level: we will move the control plane from 2026.04.2 -> 2026.05.0 pinned for the cutover, then unpin on a controlled cadence. To reduce blast radius we propose a short-version "sunset window" where the old pin can be reinstated automatically if key health checks fail.

Planned window (proposal):
- Start: Tue, 2026-06-08 22:00 UTC
- Target completion: 2026-06-09 02:00 UTC
- Reversion hold point at +30m and +90m after traffic ramp

Key asks for you:
1) Confirm primary maintenance window above (we can move by ±2 days).
2) Approve temporary egress rule to allow our ops to fetch the artifact bundle and for customers to upload snapshot backups to your S3 endpoint.
3) Confirm who will be on the FinServe bridge (names/emails) for the +30m decision.

Attached: upgrade_manifest_v1.xlsx (pins, image hashes), fast_reversion_runbook.md (step-by-step for unpin and rollback), network-egress-change-stub.txt (minimal ACL changes).

If that window works we'll schedule a dry run on staging next week and provide the final runbook with health-check thresholds.

Thanks,
Karthik
Sr. PM, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

From: Alex Park <alex.park@finserve.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: platformops@finserve.com
Date: Fri, 29 May 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pinned Version Sunset & Fast Reversion Protocol for FinServe VPC Cutover

Karthik —

Thanks for the plan. A few quick notes from Platform Ops: we can support the June 8 window but prefer a 23:00 UTC start (our on-call overlaps better). Please re-propose with that start time.

Regarding the egress rule: we need the exact CIDR ranges and a justification for every external host you will contact. We also require an account-scoped pre-signed S3 link pattern rather than opening broad write permissions.

On the bridge: I (Alex Park) and Maria Chen (maria.chen@finserve.com) will attend + we may have our Security lead if the health checks trip.

Please also include the audit hooks (who performs each step and the required evidence) — we need to feed that into our compliance ticket.

—Alex
Senior Platform Engineer
FinServe Inc

Subject: Fwd: Pinned Version Sunset & Fast Reversion Protocol for FinServe VPC Cutover

Monica / Neha —

Looping you in to confirm operational readiness and to capture the audit evidence requirements Alex requested. Short notes / ops checklist I need you to verify for FinServe:

- Start time adjustment to 23:00 UTC (per FinServe), window end 03:00 UTC.
- Egress: we will only need outbound to the artifact registry (44.33.122.10/32) and your S3 endpoint (s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com, account-limited presigned POSTs). Monica, confirm the exact ephemeral IPs the runbooks will use during the window.
- Health checks and hold points:
  - Health check A (control-plane readiness): 2 consecutive successful steady-state samples in 5 minutes.
  - Health check B (latency tail): p99 < 350ms sustained for 10m after ramp.
  - If either fails: immediate auto-unpin to 2026.04.2 and traffic divert to standby pool, then manual approval for reattempt.
- Evidence capture: timestamps for pin/unpin, runbook step executor (IAM principal), cloudtrail links, tarball of pre/post metrics snapshot.

Attachments included for the customer: upgrade_manifest_v1.xlsx, fast_reversion_runbook.md (contains command snippets and quick 'one-liners' to reinstate pin). Neha — can you confirm the runbook's 'fast unpin' script will complete within 6 minutes on our worst-case node? If not, call it out.

I will update the scheduling doc and post the bridge link once we lock the date.

Thanks,
Karthik

Subject: Re: Pinned Version Sunset & Fast Reversion Protocol for FinServe VPC Cutover

Karthik / Monica / Alex —

Quick ops confirmation after reviewing the runbook: the fast-unpin path uses an orchestrated KV flush + control-plane restart. On our staging runs the full path completed in 4m40s under load (worst-case). I will add a 60s safety margin in the runbook and include the exact ephemeral IP list we use for artifact fetches: 34.210.15.7, 34.210.15.8.

On the audit hooks: we will emit a signed artifact (sha256) + CloudTrail link and attach the metrics tarball (pre/post). I updated the shared drive doc with the evidence checklist (link below).

Changes agreed: start 2026-06-08 23:00 UTC, window end 2026-06-09 03:00 UTC. FinServe bridge: Alex Park, Maria Chen. We will not open broad egress; we'll use account-limited presigned S3 uploads (Monica will send the pattern).

Link to updated runbook and evidence checklist: https://drive.google.com/finserve/vpc-cutover-plan

Neha Kapoor
SRE, Redwood Inference
